_comment: Pin for the vendored extern/CommonLibSSE-NG tree. See extern/README.md for the update procedure.

patches.reason: Adds /EHsc. The cross-compile lane builds with clang-cl and CommonLibSSE headers use exceptions; without this the plugin's own /EHsc does not reach the interface target and unwinding is inconsistent across the boundary.
Upstream typo: the move assignment writes a_rhs.storage.address (no underscore), which does not compile. Fixed to a_rhs._storage.address.
Upstream typo: Assign() calls a_src.Begin()/End() which do not exist on the const path. Fixed to begin()/end().
